name: Bryan College
academic_ranking: Small, institutionally accredited Christian liberal arts college founded in 1930, located in Dayton, TN. Offers 50+ areas of study across associate's, bachelor's, master's, and doctorate degrees, plus professional certificates. Faith-based mission ('Christ above all') with both on-campus and online (eight-week course) program options.
financial_aid: On-campus undergraduate tuition (12-17 hours) is $21,700/year for 2026-27; full traditional package with room and board totals $31,250/year. College states it is committed to assisting students with scholarships/grants, federal/state aid, campus employment, and/or loans. Interest-free payment plan available via Nelnet Campus Commerce (3, 4, or 5 installments per semester).
facilities_notes: Athletics department located at 721 Bryan Drive, Dayton, TN 37321. Softball program supported by team athletics facilities and Sports Medicine services; no softball-specific facility details (field name, etc.) publicly listed on the softball program pages (checked 2026-07).
program_reputation: NAIA program competing in the Appalachian Athletic Conference (AAC). Bryan Lions athletics.
